check_name: Mandatory header field missing
check_description: A header field the document cannot be processed without is absent

check_name: Stated line count differs from lines received
check_description: The document states a line count that does not match what was captured

check_name: Invoice date in the future
check_description: The invoice is dated after today

check_name: Ticket number missing on the line
check_description: The line states no ticket number, so nothing resolves the PO

check_name: Ticket number not found
check_description: The stated ticket is not in FuelSphere, or matches more than one

check_name: Ticket has no order
check_description: The ticket exists and carries no order. There is no PO to invoice against

check_name: Order has no PO number
check_description: The resolved order was never given an s4_po_number

check_name: Stated PO differs from resolved PO
check_description: The invoice quotes a PO other than the one the ticket resolves to

check_name: No goods receipt against the order
check_description: Nothing records that the fuel was received

check_name: Invoiced quantity differs from goods receipt
check_description: Laddered against TOL-INV-QTY

check_name: Invoiced quantity exceeds the order
check_description: More was invoiced than was ever ordered

check_name: Unit of measure mismatch
check_description: The line and the goods receipt are in different units

check_name: Quantity zero or negative
check_description: A line quantity that is not positive. INV456 permits negative for a defuel

check_name: Unit price differs from the order
check_description: Laddered against TOL-INV-PRICE

check_name: Line value does not equal quantity times price
check_description: The arithmetic on the line does not hold

check_name: Header total differs from the sum of lines
check_description: The stated total disagrees with the derived one. The derived figure governs

check_name: Price is PROVISIONAL, comparison suspended
check_description: A proxy price cannot be compared to a contract that has not resolved

check_name: A charge with no contract component
check_description: The line names none of the components the contract carries

check_name: A contract component absent from the invoice
check_description: The contract carries a component the line does not name

check_name: Same invoice number, same vendor
check_description: This document number is already captured for this supplier

check_name: Same ticket invoiced twice
check_description: A ticket is payable once, across all billing periods

check_name: Same order and GR combination invoiced twice
check_description: One goods receipt against one order, billed more than once
